dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 01, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**TURBULENT TUESDAY: POWER HITTERS TAKE CENTER STAGE**

Dansby Swanson (Cubs) and Alec Bohm (Phillies) made their presence felt in a big way, each hitting three home runs and driving in eight and ten runs, respectively. Swanson's historic performance sparked a 23-3 Chicago Cubs rout of the San Diego Padres. 

On the mound, Noah Schultz (Orioles) and MacKenzie Gore (Rangers) put up strong outings, striking out seven and four batters, respectively. Schultz's 4.1 innings of work were a bright spot in the Orioles' 6-1 win over the White Sox. 

Meanwhile, Dansby Swanson's 3 home runs and 8 RBIs lead the Chicago Cubs to a 23-3 win over the San Diego Padres.
